panels.title: Terms Spoken
keyPoses: Wide storm-crag vista: sea-cliffs west, pale marble east, two small figures at opposite marks. Slow push in as Thor plants the haft.

panels.title: Ranging Wind
keyPoses: Medium wide: both fighters circling, cloaks lifting in cross-gust. Lateral track keeps both in frame.

panels.title: First Exchange
keyPoses: Medium: Thor overhead swing at apex; Zeus shaft high-block; spark-spray at the crossing point.

panels.title: Thrown Weapons
keyPoses: Wide: haft and shaft crossing mid-sky over the crag, both fighters bare-handed below, sky-crack forking.

panels.title: Body Blows
keyPoses: Medium-close clinch: shoulder to shoulder, Zeus taking a knee, dropped shaft on the rock.

panels.title: The Storm's Answer
keyPoses: Extreme wide crane-up: skyburst over the crag, two figures back to back at center, rain walls.

panels.title: The Final Exchange
keyPoses: Close two-shot: shaft held at Thor's brow, unstriking; four-second held silence.

panels.title: Loosing the Storm
keyPoses: Vast wide pull-back: both fighters open-handed, storm streaming east out to sea, first clear light.
